officialLinks.label: GPA formula, transcript levels, grade systems
Undergraduate graduation honors and College graduation GPA

helpIntro: Penn’s standard undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale and course-unit weighting. Enter final grades and course units to estimate current or cumulative GPA.
helpNote: A+ and A are both 4.0; there is no undergraduate D-. P and most non-final notations are excluded, while F counts at 0. Repeat rules and some study-abroad, graduate, and professional-school records require separate review.
helpExample: A 1 c.u. A earns 4.0 quality points and a 1 c.u. B+ earns 3.3. Together, 7.3 ÷ 2 c.u. = 3.65.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ earns 4.0 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.A: A earns 4.0 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- earns 3.7 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ earns 3.3 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.B: B earns 3.0 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- earns 2.7 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ earns 2.3 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.C: C earns 2.0 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- earns 1.7 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ earns 1.3 quality points per c.u.
gradeExplanations.D: D earns 1.0 quality point per c.u.; Penn undergraduate scale has no D-.
gradeExplanations.F: F earns 0 quality points and its GPA hours still count.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from cumulative GPA; credit rules depend on school.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory/progress notation is not assigned undergraduate grade points in the standard scale.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory/progress notation has no standard undergraduate grade-point value; confirm the final course outcome.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is unresolved; use the final grade when posted.
gradeExplanations.II: Extended Incomplete is unresolved; use the final grade when posted.
gradeExplanations.I*: Permanent Incomplete has no standard undergraduate grade-point value in this calculator.
gradeExplanations.NR: No grade reported; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.GR: No grade reported for student; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.PR: In progress; use the final grade when completed.

specialTypes.name: Penn undergraduate course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Use for standard undergraduate Penn courses on the common 4.0 scale.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or credit-away course
specialTypes.note: External transfer/credit-away grades generally do not enter Penn cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: Penn-approved study abroad course
specialTypes.note: Penn states approved study-abroad grades become part of the transcript and Penn GPA; confirm the posted Penn course units and grade treatment before calculating.

specialTypes.name: Graduate or professional-school course/record
specialTypes.note: Penn uses different grading systems across transcript levels and schools; do not force the undergraduate scale onto these records.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Penn repeat treatment depends on your undergraduate school and the original result; enter only attempts that your school counts in GPA and confirm unusual cases with your advisor.
